name.text: Factorials 4 - Complete the cancelling steps (drag and drop)

questiontext.text:
Simplify each factorial fraction by completing the steps. Drag the correct item into each box.

Part A: Simplify 9! ÷ 7!

  1. Expand the larger factorial only until it reaches the smaller one: 9! = 9 × [[3]] × [[1]]
  2. Substitute into the fraction: (9 × 8 × 7!) ÷ [[1]]
  3. Cancel the common factor. The [[1]] on the top and bottom cancel, leaving 9 × [[3]]
  4. Multiply: 9 × 8 = [[2]]

Part B: Simplify 100! ÷ 98!

  1. Expand the larger factorial: 100! = 100 × [[5]] × [[4]]
  2. Cancel the [[4]] on the top and bottom, leaving 100 × [[5]] = [[6]]

generalfeedback.text:
Worked Solution

To simplify a fraction of factorials, expand the larger one only until it matches the smaller one, then cancel.

\(\dfrac{9!}{7!} = \dfrac{9 \times 8 \times 7!}{7!} = 9 \times 8 = 72\)

\(\dfrac{100!}{98!} = \dfrac{100 \times 99 \times 98!}{98!} = 100 \times 99 = 9900\)
